data.text: John, Kate, Jack, Emma—at 100 tons, we could each take 10 and leave 50 to double back to 100. But I’m proposing we each choose 15 tons this month: $15,000 apiece instead of $10,000. I intend to choose 15, and I’m asking you to match that rather than hold back while others take a larger immediate payout. Our choices are private and simultaneous, so nobody can wait to see what’s left before deciding. This isn’t sustainable: if all five take 15, only 25 tons remain, growing to 50 next month, which cuts future earning opportunities. That’s a real cost—but I’m pushing for the extra $5,000 each now. Who’s willing to choose 15?
